text: Iran has seized a Chinese-owned Marshall Islands-flagged oil tanker that was heading for Houston while it was transiting through international waters. The U.S. Navy has demanded that Iran release the ship immediately, the ship issuing a distress call to the U.S. Navy at around 1 p.m. today, and Iran's saying that it just seized the boat after it collided with one of their ships.
